description: List the image files stored on the merchant's account. Answers 'what images do I have', 'do I already have a photo of X', 'what did I upload recently', and it is where you get a file id before deleting one, or a URL to reuse on a product or category. Newest first; search is a case-insensitive match on the FILE NAME only. LIMITATIONS, state them rather than working around them: there is no other sorting, and no title, alt text, description, folder, file size or image dimensions here — the Media screen in the cabinet shows those, but they are stored by a different service that this tool cannot read, so it may list files this tool does not and vice versa. There is also NO WAY TO RENAME a file from here: if the merchant asks to rename one, or to change its alt text, title or folder, say that has to be done on the Media screen in the cabinet. Do not delete and re-upload to fake a rename.

search.description: Filter by file name, e.g. "logo" or "shirt"
